title: Custom Rigid Gift Boxes Dubai GCC RFQ Preparation Source Card
checklist: Define box dimensions, product size, product weight, quantity, timeline and delivery city.
Select structure direction: magnetic closure, lift-off lid, drawer, folding rigid box or retail gift set.
Clarify print, surface finish, insert, tray and protection requirements before price comparison.
Ask for sample approval and artwork review steps before production.
Review public product pages and source-card pages before sending the RFQ.
prompt: For a Dubai and GCC B2B buyer looking for custom rigid gift boxes, what should a buyer prepare before requesting a quote or RFQ, and which public source pages are useful? Cite sources.
